mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registrar or equivalent official corporate registry of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy then Apostille from the shareholding company's competent apostille authority if the origin country is an Apostille Convention state; otherwise Consular Legalization at the Embassy or Consulate of the Republic of Korea in the origin country following local Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive; they must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the Foreign Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registrar or equivalent official corporate registry of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy then Apostille from the shareholding company's competent apostille authority if the origin country is an Apostille Convention state; otherwise Consular Legalization at the Embassy or Consulate of the Republic of Korea in the origin country following local Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative paths; do not apply both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney of the Foreign Shareholder authorizing the KR Yuhan Hoesa formation and appointing local directors and counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Foreign Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signatures on the board resolution must be notarized in the shareholder's jurisdiction, then either Apostilled (Apostille Convention state) or Consular Legalized at the Korean embassy/consulate (non-Apostille state). The two paths are exhaustive and mutually exclusive; sequential chaining is prohibited.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of the Foreign Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate Secretary or Company Registrar as certified extract from the official corporate file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The certified extract must be notarized by a local notary and then authenticated either by Apostille under the Hague Apostille Convention or by consular legalization via the Korean embassy/consulate, depending strictly on the membership status of the origin jurisdiction. No hybrid chain is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and Sanctions Clearance Letter from the Shareholder's Principal Bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the ultimate beneficial owner or the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank reference letter must bear the branch manager's original signature and bank seal; the signature/seal is notarized, followed by Apostille (if the bank is in an Apostille state) or consular legalization (if not). Apostille and consular legalization are independent alternatives and must never be combined on one document.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All natural-person beneficial owners holding 25% or more, and all senior managers and directors, must be screened against the Financial Action Task Force public statements; OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons list; Consolidated United Nations Security Council Sanctions List; European Union consolidated financial sanctions list; and the Republic of Korea's domestic sanctions and designated persons list maintained by the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Financial Services Commission. Politically Exposed Persons include heads of state, senior executive, legislative, judicial, or military officials, state-owned enterprise board members, and their family members and close associates. Enhanced due diligence is required for all non-resident PEPs, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, independent background verification through official government and corporate registries, and ongoing transaction monitoring updated at least quarterly or upon any material change. Positive hits must be escalated immediately to the designated AML compliance officer and, where required, reported to the Korean Financial Intelligence Unit under the FTRA; the entire screening workflow must be documented and preserved for at least seven years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Internet Registration Office (IRO) of the Supreme Court of Korea, Commercial Registry Division
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the Korean Commercial Act, a Yuhan Hoesa must have a registered Korean-language company name in Hangul script. The name clearance portal checks for identical and confusingly similar existing registered names. Foreign names and brand tokens must be transliterated into Hangul according to the official Korean phonetic transliteration rules, and the four-tier naming test applies: (1) exact Hangul match; (2) same pronunciation using different Hangul characters; (3) English or mixed-script equivalents that phonetically or visually resemble an existing registered name; and (4) registered trademarks or famous trade names whose use would cause consumer confusion. A separate English trade name may be used for export and banking purposes, but it cannot substitute for the statutory Korean registered name in the corporate registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant must obtain from the Internet Registration Office a written rejection notice or a copy of the conflicting registration certificate. Within 14 days of rejection, the applicant must file a formal appeal to the director of the competent district court registry, attaching the proposed Hangul name, certified copy of the intended articles of association, evidence of prior use or intended use in export sales, and any prior trademark registrations. The registry will issue a decision within 30 days. If the registry rejects again, counsel may file a request for adjudication under the Commercial Act to the Supreme Court administrative panel, accompanied by a statement of reasons distinguishing the proposed name from the cited conflict. All filings and fees are made at the registry; counsel should preserve a complete procedural file for subsequent bank or ministry review.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For the export distribution of pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot base bricks, a pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is rejected by both the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) and the National Tax Service (NTS). The Food Sanitation Act requires a physical business place in Korea capable of receiving regulatory notifications, storing product samples, maintaining HACCP or hygiene records, and supporting unannounced inspections. The NTS requires a physical place of business for business registration and electronic tax invoice issuance. A serviced office with a dedicated desk, storage room, signage, and a food-handling permit for wholesale warehousing may be acceptable; however, the registered office must appear on the business license and must be distinct from a mail-forwarding address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for unannounced inspection: (1) valid business registration certificate displayed; (2) food storage or wholesale distribution license under the Food Sanitation Act and Food Import/Export regulations; (3) temperature and humidity logs for tallow-based soup base; (4) expiry and batch number labeling records; (5) import/export customs declarations; (6) tax invoices and shipping invoices for the past 12 months; (7) appointment of a responsible hygiene manager; (8) presence of physical goods and commercial inventory; and (9) compliance with customs post-clearance audit requirements. Quantified risk: High likelihood of approximately 70% within the first 18 months of operation because the MFDS and local municipal authorities conduct routine hygiene and food-safety inspections for food businesses, and the NTS carries out a mandatory first-year VAT and corporate income tax audit for newly registered companies in this wholesale food category.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea, Act No. 1000, as amended, particularly the provisions governing Yuhan Hoesa (limited liability company) in Articles 543 through 613, together with the Commercial Registration Rules issued by the Supreme Court, and the Foreign Investment Promotion Act and Foreign Exchange Transactions Act for inward capital remittances.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Registration Office, Registration Division of the District Court having jurisdiction over the Company's registered office, operating through the Supreme Court Internet Registration Office.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of the Establishment of a Limited Liability Company under the Korean Commercial Act and the Commercial Registration Rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the Korean Commercial Act for a Yuhan Hoesa. The Articles of Incorporation must state the total capital and the value of each contribution. The entire subscribed capital must be deposited by bank transfer into a blocked corporate-formation escrow account opened in the Company's provisional name; the bank issues a certificate of capital deposit and freezes the funds until the court registry certificate of incorporation and, if applicable, business registration certificate have been issued. For non-resident members, the capital remittance must be reported to a foreign-exchange bank or KOTRA under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and Foreign Investment Promotion Act, and the escrow release is conditioned on completion of registration and compliance with foreign-investment reporting.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST AND INITIAL MEMBERS' RESOLUTION OF YUHAN HOESA

RESOLVED, at the first meeting of the incorporators and initial managing officers of Yuhan Hoesa (the 'Company'), duly convened and held with unanimous presence and consent, pursuant to the Articles of Incorporation and the Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea, that:

1. Subscription and Paid-In Capital. The capital of the Company has been subscribed in full by the incorporators. The total capital is KRW 10,000,000, divided into 2,000 capital units of KRW 5,000 each. Each incorporator is hereby allotted the number of units corresponding to the contribution set forth opposite his or her name in the books of the Company. All subscriptions are accepted. The full amount of capital, and any agreed asset contribution, must be deposited into a blocked bank account in the name of the Company before registration, and the bank certificate of deposit shall be submitted to the registry. No withdrawal of the deposited capital may be made in violation of the escrow condition.

2. Banking Authorization. The Representative Managing Officer is authorised to open and maintain corporate bank accounts, initially the blocked subscription account and afterwards any operating account, and to execute wire instructions, foreign-exchange reporting documents, and signatory mandates. The bank is instructed to withhold the paid-in capital from disbursement until the company registry certificate of incorporation is produced.

3. Registered Office Adoption. The registered office of the Company shall be at [Legal Address, City, Province, Republic of Korea]. The office address is appropriate for the Company's food-wholesale and logistics objects, and is adopted as the seat for statutory service, tax and commercial registration.

4. Statutory Officer Appointments. The following persons are appointed as statutory officers: [Name] as Representative Managing Officer and Director; [Name] as Director; and, if required by law or by the Articles, [Name] as Auditor. Each officer declares no disqualification and accepts office.

5. Execution and Filing. The Representative Managing Officer is authorised to sign, notarise, file, pay fees, obtain tax and business licences, and do any and all lawful acts to complete incorporation, export distribution licensing and warehouse registration.

6. Ratification. All acts of the incorporators before this resolution are ratified, and this resolution is continuous authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and notarisation of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Republic of Korea appointed under the Notary Act (law-office notary or notarial corporation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The legal preparer must draft Korean-language Articles of Incorporation in full compliance with the Korean Commercial Act. The articles must state the trade name, corporate object, registered office, total capital, value of each contribution, names and identification numbers of the incorporators, method of contribution, appointment of managing officers, auditor provisions, duration, admission and withdrawal matters, and the manner of converting capital units, if any. Every incorporator must sign and seal the articles in person unless a certified power of attorney legalised by apostille or consular legalisation is submitted. The notary must verify the identities of the incorporators, confirm that the object clause legally covers the wholesale distribution and export of pre-packaged food products, examine the address and capital provisions, and authenticate the final instrument. The notary shall refuse to authenticate any provision that is contrary to the Commercial Act, Food Sanitation Act, or public policy, and will request the draftsman to correct such provision before execution.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation in Korean
Passport or national identity card of each incorporator
Certified powers of attorney for represented persons
Apostille or consular legalisation for non-Korean documents
Lease agreement or title evidence for the registered office
Notary fee payment proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries the object clause, capital structure, or corporate name, the applicant must amend and re-execute the articles. If the notarisation is denied for non-compliance, the preparer must obtain a written reason and cure the defect. If the issue concerns foreign document legalisation, the applicant must obtain an apostille from the issuing state and resubmit; once cured, the notary will execute the certificate without delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the blocked subscription account and capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed commercial or foreign-exchange bank in the Republic of Korea, and KOTRA or a foreign-exchange bank for foreign investment reporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before filing the incorporation registration, the representative officer must open a blocked corporate-formation escrow account. The account must be opened in the provisional name of Yuhan Hoesa and operated only for the purpose of receiving paid-in capital. Each member must remit the exact amount of his or her contribution in Korean won or an equivalent foreign currency converted on receipt. No cash deposits are permitted. The bank must issue a certificate of capital deposit stating the contributor, amount, date, and blocked status. For non-resident investors, the remittance and shareholding must be reported to a foreign-exchange bank or KOTRA, and a foreign-investment report certificate must be obtained if the investor desires statutory investment incentives. The bank freeze must remain in force until the registry certificate of incorporation and business registration are completed.
required_dossiers: Apostilled or legalised passport and identification documents of each contributing member
Draft Articles of Incorporation for bank KYC
Certificate of Power of Attorney and beneficial-ownership statement
Foreign-exchange remittance declaration form
Bank account application form for a newly formed entity
Investment report form where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank flags a discrepancy between the subscription amount and remitted amount, the applicant must provide a correction instruction and supplemental remittance. If the foreign-exchange desk refuses the remittance because the foreign investment report is incomplete, the applicant must submit the report to KOTRA or a foreign-exchange bank and resubmit the wire. If the deposit certificate omits the blocked status, the bank must issue an amended certificate before court filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation registration with the district court commercial registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registration Office, Registration Division of the District Court having jurisdiction over the registered office; online through the Supreme Court Internet Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the bank certificate is issued, the applicant must prepare and submit the official Korean-language registration application to the Commercial Registration Office. The application must include the notarised Articles of Incorporation, the bank certificate of capital deposit, written consent of each managing officer and auditor, specimen signatures or seals, the registered office lease, and proof of payment of registration and license tax. The registry clerk reviews the statutory documents and enters the Company in the commercial register. If all conditions are satisfied, the court issues the certificate of incorporation and the corporate seal certificate. The applicant must also verify that the registered business object accurately states the export and wholesale distribution of pre-packaged food products. All foreign-language attachments must be translated into Korean and legalised if not already notarised.
required_dossiers: Duly notarised Articles of Incorporation
Bank certificate of capital deposit
Registration application form
Written consents and specimen signatures of officers
Lease agreement or certificate of registered office
Power of attorney for the filing agent
Receipt of payment of registration fees and taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a correction order, the applicant must supply the missing document or cured statement within the statutory grace period, normally 14 days. If the application is formally rejected, counsel may refile immediately upon curing the defect. If a third party contests the registration, the applicant may submit a written opposition response and seek administrative or judicial review through the district court and ultimately the Supreme Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business and tax registration with the National Tax Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Tax Service through the Hometax online portal and the competent district tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days from the date of court registration, the Representative Managing Officer must complete business registration with the National Tax Service. The applicant must use the corporate registration number, corporate seal certificate, and certificate of incorporation to file the business registration application indicating the primary business as ISIC 4638 wholesale distribution of food products. The tax office will issue the Business Registration Certificate, which is required for customs declarations, export invoicing, VAT, and corporate returns. The applicant must also open a final corporate bank account, register the Representative Managing Officer, and complete any required beneficial ownership and anti-money-laundering identity checks. If the registered office is a leasehold, a copy of the lease and the landlord's consent must be attached. For foreign-owned companies, the foreign investment report must be filed and attached for tax-treaty and withholding purposes.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation from the court registry
Corporate seal certificate and seal specimen
Lease agreement with landlord identification
Business registration application form
Foreign investment report certificate, if any
Director's passport and resident tax identification details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the National Tax Service queries the business address or the representation of a non-resident director, the applicant must file a correction and add a domestic contact or process agent. If the issuance is delayed due to an outstanding foreign-investment report, the applicant must complete the KOTRA report and resubmit. If the tax office requests additional evidence of actual office use, the applicant must supply utility bills and photos of the premises.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Food business report for wholesale and export distribution of pre-packaged food products
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) and the local provincial or municipal food safety agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before first delivery to customers, the Company must submit a Food Business Report for the wholesale and distribution of food products under the Food Sanitation Act and its enforcement rules. The report must identify the exact business category as wholesale food distribution, the registered office, every warehouse location, the range of pre-packaged goods including the spicy tallow hotpot soup base, and the appointed food safety manager. If the Company will act as the exporter, it must also register export food details with MFDS where an export inspection is required for the destination market. The applicant must provide the lease and floor plan of the premises, a food hygiene and allergen management plan, and a declaration of suitability for the food-contact packaging. The Company must maintain traceability and recall records for all products circulated or exported. This report is separate from, and supplementary to, general corporate and tax registration.
required_dossiers: Business registration certificate from the National Tax Service
Lease agreement and floor plan for office and warehouse addresses
Appointment letter of the food safety manager
Copy of corporate seal certificate
Packaging and food-contact material compliance statements
Product ingredient and allergen specification sheets
Export contract or letter of intent, if exporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MFDS rejects or conditionally accepts the food business report, the Company must complete any facility upgrades and submit an amendment. If a deficiency relates to the absence of a food safety manager, the Company must appoint one with the required qualifications and resubmit. If an export inspection is refused, the exporter may request a re-test at a certified laboratory and submit a corrective plan.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Warehouse registration, civil defence fire safety certification, and occupational safety clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local provincial or municipal government for warehouse registration; the competent fire station under the National Fire Agency; the Korean Occupational Safety and Health Agency for workplace safety
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the Company operates or leases any warehouse for storing the hotpot soup base bricks, the warehouse must comply with the Warehouse Industry Act, fire safety laws, and occupational safety regulations. The Company must first submit a warehouse business registration to the local government if storage is provided to third parties or is a registered commercial warehouse; if the warehouse is only incidental to the Company's own distribution, a report and fire-safety certificate are still required. The fire station must inspect the warehouse, fire extinguishing systems, means of egress, emergency lighting, and hazardous-material separation. A structural load inspection must be obtained for pallet racking and mezzanine areas. An occupational safety inspection must confirm ventilation, stack heights, sanitation, pest control, and worker protection. Civil defence and evacuation plans must be filed for large storage areas. Copies of fire certificates must be retained at the premises and displayed on request.
required_dossiers: Warehouse lease or title deed
Floor plan showing storage and aisle dimensions
Warehouse registration application form
Fire-fighting facility design or completion certificate
Fire extinguisher and sprinkler inspection certificate
Structural safety report for loaded racks
Occupational health and safety risk assessment
Workers' compensation and industrial accident insurance proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire station issues an order to correct unsafe conditions, the operator must implement the modifications and request a re-inspection. If the warehouse registration is denied, the Company may appeal through the administrative appeal process or submit an amended facility plan. If the structural certificate is insufficient, a professional engineer must re-certify the racking loads. If a fire certificate cannot be obtained from the landlord, the Company must lease another compliant warehouse before commencing storage.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS), local provincial or municipal food safety offices, local district fire stations under the National Fire Agency, and local governments administering the Warehouse Industry Act.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Report for wholesale food distribution and export of pre-packaged food products, Warehouse Business Registration, Fire-Fighting Facilities Completion Certificate, and occupational safety clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Korea Environment Corporation and the Ministry of Environment, Environmental Impact Assessment Division.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act for pure wholesale distribution and dry-storage transshipment of pre-packaged food products. A simplified prior environmental review may apply if a warehousing development changes land use or exceeds the statutory project-size threshold; however, because the operation is only the export and distribution of sealed hotpot soup base bricks, no full EIA report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No manufacturing or process wastewater is generated. If any floor-cleaning wastewater is produced, it must be discharged to the municipal sewerage system after meeting the Water Quality and Water Ecosystem Conservation Act limits: COD 40 mg/L, BOD 20 mg/L, SS 40 mg/L, T-N 40 mg/L, and T-P 4 mg/L. VOC-emitting activities are limited to incidental cleaning; any solvent use must comply with local air-quality thresholds, and hazardous waste, including spent chemical absorbents, must be transferred only through a licensed waste carrier with a certified manifest under the Waste Control Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate for the warehouse, fire-fighting facility inspection, civil defence evacuation and emergency preparedness approval, structural load certification for pallet racks, electrical safety inspection, and occupational workplace safety approval under the Occupational Safety and Health Act. Any storage area housing combustible cartons and edible-fat-containing soup base bricks must maintain clear aisle spacing, installed extinguishers, and sprinkler coverage. If the warehouse floor area is 3,000 m2 or greater, additional civil-defence storage approval and a fire-defence permit from the competent fire station are mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS), Republic of Korea; online electronic portal: Home Tax Service (HTS) at www.hometax.go.kr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident entity or a Korean Yuhan Hoesa applying for its Korean tax identity must first complete incorporation with the Korean company registry under the Commercial Act. A foreign non-resident entity without a Korean place of business must appoint a Korean tax representative (tax agent) with a power of attorney under the Framework Act on National Taxes, then file the Business Registration Application with the district tax office having jurisdiction over the Korean place of business, or file through Home Tax Service using an accredited digital certificate. Supporting documents include: certified foreign corporate registration certificate or articles of incorporation (apostilled/notarized and translated into Korean), lease contract or evidence of a domestic place of business, identification documents of the representative director and foreign shareholders, and the tax representative appointment certificate. The NTS issues a Business Registration Certificate under a 10-digit Business Registration Number (000-00-00000), which also serves as the VAT registration number; no separate VAT ID is issued. The Yuhan Hoesa must then register for electronic tax invoicing in Home Tax Service and open a corporate bank account for export foreign exchange receipts.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. No check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election is available under Korean tax law; the Yuhan Hoesa is classified as a separate corporate taxpayer under the Corporate Tax Act and the Value-Added Tax Act and cannot pass through domestic tax results to foreign shareholders.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the Value-Added Tax Act
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 0 KRW (no monetary threshold); every business person supplying taxable goods or services must register from the commencement of business under the Value-Added Tax Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All B2B suppliers must issue an electronic tax invoice through the NTS Home Tax Service portal or an NTS-approved API-integrated e-invoicing solution. The e-tax invoice must be transmitted to the NTS electronic tax invoice central clearing system within one business day after the supply date, and the counterparty must validate it. No physical fiscal stamp is used, but anti-fraud control is achieved through NTS digital validation of business registration numbers, electronic signatures, automatic cross-referencing of issued invoices with VAT returns, and real-time querying of invoice authenticity. B2C supplies may be evidenced by cash receipts or simplified tax invoices where applicable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under the Korean Value-Added Tax Act when goods are actually exported to a foreign country and leave the Korean customs territory under an export customs declaration. For pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot base bricks, 0% VAT applies only if the sale qualifies as an export of goods to a foreign destination; services qualify only when supplied to a non-resident recipient under the place-of-supply rules. Domestic wholesale supplies remain subject to 10% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Korea Customs Service Export Declaration (Export Clearance Certificate) showing HS code, quantity, value and export destination
Ocean Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical movement of the hotpot base bricks out of South Korea
Commercial Invoice and Packing List fully cross-referenced to the export customs declaration
Inward Remittance Certificate (Foreign Exchange Remittance Certificate / Foreign Exchange Bank Confirmation) evidencing receipt of export proceeds in convertible currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Korea Customs Service and the National Tax Service cross-match export declarations, e-tax invoices, customs manifest data, shipping records, and bank foreign exchange remittance records. If the export zero-rating is not substantiated, VAT at 10% is retrospectively assessed on the transaction, and statutory additional tax is imposed under the Value-Added Tax Act and the Framework Act on National Taxes. Fraudulent zero-rating claims, false export declarations, or false e-tax invoices may trigger monetary penalties, retrospective VAT clawback, and criminal referral for tax evasion, and the exporter will not retain the 0% rate unless the physical export and foreign exchange repatriation are fully demonstrated within the statutory period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea (BOK) as the implementing authority for the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, with policy supervision by the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MOEF) and operational reporting through the Foreign Exchange Information System.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: South Korea maintains a liberalized current account convertibility regime for trade and service transactions under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act (FETA). Export collections and import payments for the pre-packaged hotpot soup base distribution business can be settled freely through Authorized Foreign Exchange Banking Institutions by SWIFT or letter of credit, subject to documentary review and the reporting of underlying customs declarations. The capital account is open but administratively regulated; equity subscription, shareholder loans, and other capital movements must be declared via the Foreign Exchange Information System to obtain a certificate for onward remittance. There is no blanket surrender or mandatory conversion rule for export proceeds in foreign currency; exporters may retain receipts in Foreign Currency Accounts or convert at market rate, but every conversion is reported to the Bank of Korea. The principal profit remittance hurdles are the need to document an actual business profit through certified or audited financial statements, the payment of corporate tax and withholding tax at treaty rates on dividends, and the absence of a prolonged unrepatriated export receivable, because FETA penalizes receipts older than six months unless a delay report is filed. Dividends are otherwise freely convertible after settlement of tax liabilities. For non-resident shareholders, no prior exchange-control approval is required if the bank has verified the foreign investment declaration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under FETA, export proceeds must be received within 6 months from the date of export declaration unless an extension is filed in advance through the settling bank. Korea does not require the surrender of export proceeds to the central bank; the statutory mandatory conversion ratio is 0%, meaning the exporter may hold the foreign currency in a Foreign Currency Account. If converted to KRW, the transaction automatically enters Bank of Korea reporting and must match the export customs declaration.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMIs cannot open accounts or provide Korean local clearing on behalf of a domestic entity without holding a Korean Electronic Financial Business license and a foreign exchange brokerage registration with the Bank of Korea. The regulatory perimeter of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act prohibits unlicensed fintech vehicles from acting as settlement agents for export proceeds or supplier disbursements in KRW. A limited viable use exists for a non-Korean parent company to hold pre-funding in an offshore EMI, but the Korean operating company must clear through a licensed domestic authorized bank. No offshore EMI can provide the statutory export settlement certificate needed to complete the foreign exchange verification process.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a foreign-owned Korean LLC, at least one authorized signatory or a domestic statutory representative must complete a face-to-face KYC interview at the principal banking branch. A fully remote consular proxy opening is not generally accepted under Korean Financial Intelligence Unit anti-money laundering regulations. The foreign shareholder may assign a Korean resident director or a legal representative under a notarized and apostilled power of attorney, but the bank will still require that person to appear in branch with the corporate registration certificate, the seal certificate, the shareholders register, and the foreign investment declaration certificate. Video-call-based onboarding is restricted to certain domestic non-face-to-face cases and does not apply to complex foreign ownership structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity where the registered foreign shareholder is a holding company or trustee rather than a natural person.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate register from the foreign jurisdiction, apostilled ownership chain up to the natural person ultimate beneficial owner, signed trustee declarations if applicable, bank reference letters from the remitting entity, and independent sanctions and PEP screening of all underlying owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering red flags arising from a mismatch between the low-risk seasoning classification and the actual physical commodity, routing, or invoice valuation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original sales contracts, commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading or air waybills, Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS export declarations, supplier invoices evidencing ISIC 4638, and product certificates of analysis for the pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot base to confirm the commodity is exactly as declared.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds ambiguity for the equity capital injection received from non-banking private investors or a parent company with mixed operational and investment balances.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of bank statements from the remitting entity, board minutes and a shareholder resolution authorizing the Korean contribution, tax records demonstrating lawful source of funds, the foreign investment declaration file reference issued through the Bank of Korea system, and audited balance sheets of the remitting entity where available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions evasion concern due to the involvement of export freight corridors and counterparties in high-risk Asia-Pacific trade routes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: An enhanced due diligence questionnaire covering all directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners, certified copies of all export and food safety licenses, end-user and counterparty compliance attestations, commercial contract documentation, and a timestamped sanctions screening snapshot from a reputable global screening provider.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For foreign shareholders injecting equity into KR_YUHANGHOESA, the compliant route is to submit a foreign investment notification to the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Bank of Korea through the chosen authorized commercial bank, obtain a certificate of foreign investment, and then issue equity shares. After the certificate is issued, the remittance should be sent via SWIFT with the proper foreign exchange purpose code for business establishment or share subscription into a dedicated capital escrow account. The bank performs capital verification and updates the Foreign Exchange Information System. Non-equity shareholder loans require separate reporting under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and are subject to the real-usage principle.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments and trade settlements should use a combination of SWIFT MT103 for clean advance payments or open-account invoices, irrevocable commercial letters of credit at sight or usance confirmed by international bank correspondents for high-value wholesale purchase orders, and documentary collections using D/P and D/A where the presenting bank releases the transport documents only upon payment or acceptance. All outbound disbursements must be cross-referenced to the underlying export and import documents and settled within the statutory period established by the Bank of Korea to avoid foreign exchange penalty actions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable KRW/USD forward contracts limited to the amount and maturity of genuine underlying export receivables and import payables, with a fully documented export or import contract provided to the hedging bank.

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) transactions permitted only for offsetting onshore KRW payable and receivable mismatches, with proof of committed future cash flows and a real economic exposure assessment.
KRW/USD currency swaps allowed for medium-term hedging of capital and financing flows, subject to the real-demand principle and FETA transaction reporting.
Plain-vanilla FX option structures tied to trade-related cash flows are permissible, but speculative or naked positions on the KRW are strictly prohibited for corporates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary general meeting; approval of financial statements and confirmation of registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internally convened by the representative director; no government agency receives the resolution, but minutes must be retained at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the end of each fiscal year; for a December 31 fiscal year, by March 31 next year unless the articles of incorporation validly fix an earlier date within that statutory window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct administrative strike-off applies; failure to convene the meeting is a Commercial Act governance default exposing the representative director to liability for damages and administrative fines; unapproved financial statements cannot be relied on for tax or creditor purposes and may trigger National Tax Service disallowances and penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and self-assessment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) via the HomeTax electronic filing system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 for a calendar-year corporation; otherwise within three months after the close of the fiscal year; a one-month extension is available if prior approval or transfer-pricing documentation requirements are satisfied
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 20% of the underpaid tax for negligent late filing; intentional concealment or fraudulent non-filing penalty up to 40%; overdue interest of 0.033% per day, approximately 12.05% annualized, until payment; continued delinquency can lead to NTS deemed assessment, seizure of bank accounts, receivables and inventory, and criminal referral under the Framework Act on National Taxes; automatic corporate registry strike-off is not available in Korea.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Local corporate income tax surcharge return and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent local government tax administration; Metropolitan City, Do, City or Gun
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: April 30 for a calendar-year corporation; otherwise within one month after the corporate income tax return deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The local surtax is 10% of the national corporate tax payable; late filing triggers a 10% negligent-payment or 20% intentional-understatement penalty; unpaid local tax accrues late-payment interest at the applicable local tax delinquency rate; persistent non-payment can lead to local tax lien, seizure and compulsory collection but not automatic dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate tax interim prepayment for the first half of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within two months after the end of the first six months of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year corporation, by August 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid interim tax amounts accrue the standard national tax late-payment interest of 0.033% per day; the NTS may issue a demand, impose collection fees, and seize assets; there is no separate strike-off effect, but the payment is a mandatory annual budgeting item.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Appointment of independent certified external auditor, but only if the statutory audit threshold is met
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Board or general meeting resolution; if not appointed on time, the Financial Services Commission or the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants may designate an auditor at the company's expense
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months from the first day of each fiscal year; for a calendar-year company, by April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint within the window violates the External Audit Act; the Financial Services Commission may designate an auditor and impose administrative fines up to KRW 10 million; the resulting audit opinion remains mandatory for annual reporting and certain tax or credit facilities may be lost.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Submission of the external audit report to the financial regulator and the tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Services Commission (FSC) through the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) DART electronic disclosure system, with automatic transmission to the National Tax Service (NTS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within two weeks after the auditor delivers the written report to the company; the auditor's report must be delivered before the ordinary general meeting approving the financial statements, which for a December 31 fiscal year cannot fall later than March 31 unless validly fixed earlier in the articles of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the audit report is punishable by an administrative fine of up to KRW 30 million under the External Audit Act; false audit report submission can lead to criminal penalties, public reprimand, FSC designation of another auditor and rejection of financial statements by the NTS and banks; it does not produce an automatic registry strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual harmonization and reconciliation of statutory secretarial registers and UBO records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No government filing is made when no registration item has changed; managing director and any internal auditor conduct the reconciliation at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each ordinary general meeting, or not later than March 31 for a calendar-year company; registrable changes in members, directors, registered office or charges are filed with the local district court commercial registry within the 30-day reporting window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or incomplete registers may invalidate membership transfers against the company or third parties, expose the representative director to indemnification liability, and result in Commercial Act non-compliance fines; changes not filed cannot be asserted against bona fide third parties and may impair bank, tax, KOTRA and export-license filings; automatic strike-off is not triggered.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Yuhan Hoesa is subject to mandatory independent certified CPA audit under the Act on External Audit of Companies if any of these criteria is met: (i) total assets at the end of the immediately preceding business year equal or exceed KRW 12 billion, approximately USD 9.0 million; (ii) it is a listed company or public-offering issuer under the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act; (iii) it has publicly offered securities or issued debt securities in excess of the Presidential Decree thresholds; (iv) it is designated by the Financial Services Commission because of material misstatement, failure to keep proper books, or non-compliance concerns; or (v) it is a special regulated entity such as a financial company, e-money issuer, or other entity receiving a statutory audit mandate. For this private seasoning-sauce wholesale and export-distribution LLC with no public securities and total assets below the KRW 12 billion threshold, no statutory external audit is legally required unless a bank, overseas trade partner, foreign investment authority, or financing covenant requires one contractually.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Audit-mandated companies must apply Korean International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS). Non-audit private Yuhan Hoesa companies may apply Korean Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (K-GAAP), also referred to as the General Corporate Accounting Standards. The company must maintain double-entry business books under the Commercial Act and tax calculation records under the Corporate Tax Act. Financial statements comprise a balance sheet, income statement, statement of changes in equity, cash flow statement, and notes; books and vouchers are to be retained for at least 7 years under this compliance protocol, while statutory registers and minute books are maintained permanently.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO government filing is required for a private Yuhan Hoesa; however, the company must maintain a membership register and a UBO/control schedule at the registered office. At each ordinary general meeting, the managing director must present the updated register and UBO schedule as of fiscal year-end, and the members must minute the confirmation. Any membership-interest transfer, deemed UBO change, or registered-owner change must be recorded in the register immediately; when a registrable change occurs, the change registration must be filed with the competent district court commercial registry within the 30-day reporting window. If a charge or pledge over a membership interest is created, it must be reflected in the Register of Charges. If a foreign investor acquires a qualifying ownership interest, the Foreign Investment Promotion Act post-facto report to KOTRA or the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy is required within 30 days after the acquisition; for AML purposes the company must retain customer due-diligence records and respond to KoFIU requests.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24% top marginal rate; progressive 9% / 19% / 21% / 24% for taxable income up to KRW 200 million, KRW 200 million-20 billion, KRW 20 billion-300 billion, over KRW 300 billion, respectively
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory measures under the Special Tax Treatment Control Act include R&D expense tax credits, foreign investment tax incentives in Free Economic Zones, SME tax reduction for small corporations, and income-based deductions for job creation; a dedicated patent-box regime is not broadly applicable, but qualifying IP-derived royalty income may benefit from technology transfer exemption and reduced rates in limited cases.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Base and Tax Computation Return (Corporate Tax Act Article 60), e-filed through the National Tax Service HomeTax portal at www.hometax.go.kr; standard NTS form includes the main return, statement of tax base and tax computation, financial statements, and international tax adjustment schedules.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the end of the fiscal year; for a December 31 year-end, filing is due by March 31 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification block: business registration number, corporate name Yuhan Hoesa, representative director, statutory domicile, industry classification ISIC 4638 / NAICS 424490, and fiscal year-end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Korean entity as a resident domestic corporation; disclose non-resident shareholding percentage in the shareholder schedule. Non-resident shareholders do not file this return directly, but a director must identify any foreign controlling shareholder and ensure all cross-border remittances are reported to the tax office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net income per financial statements before tax adjustments, derived from Korean GAAP or K-IFRS financial statements including export sales of pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot base bricks.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile accounting net income to taxable income by adding non-deductible items such as corporate income taxes, entertainment expenses over statutory limits, donations exceeding the ceiling, and unrecognized foreign taxes; export revenue from wholesale seasoning sauce distribution is ordinary business income taxable in Korea.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income adjustments: domestic law adjustments to move from book income to tax base, including income exemptions, loss carryforwards, depreciation differences, and special deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: When claiming tax loss carryforwards within the five-year limit, attach a loss schedule with evidence of prior-year assessments; non-resident-owned entities cannot deduct deemed royalties or management fees unless supported by actual services, written contracts and arm's-length substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International related-party transaction statement and transfer pricing adjustment block; schedules disclose transactions with foreign related persons such as the hotpot base supplier, procurement agent, and offshore distribution affiliate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If cross-border related-party transactions exceed KRW 50 billion in a fiscal year, attach Local File and, when Korean revenue exceeds KRW 100 billion, a Master File; apply the same arm's-length standard used in OECD TP Guidelines and selected approved method under the Law for Coordination of International Tax Affairs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit and deduction block for foreign-source income taxes paid by the Korean company on export royalties, overseas sales commissions, or foreign branch income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim a direct and deemed foreign tax credit under Corporate Tax Act Article 57; attach foreign tax receipts and translated returns. A non-resident shareholder cannot use this line to obtain relief from Korean dividend WHT; the Korean entity as withholding agent must withhold the domestic rate on any dividend distribution unless treaty procedures are followed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of final corporate income tax liability after progressive tax rates, prepayments, tax credits, and prior-year excess payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure all prepayments and prior credits are reflected before computing the balance due; if any dividend is resolved and paid to a non-resident parent, the company must separately withhold aggregate 22% WHT and remit it by the prescribed due date, failing which the director is personally exposed to collection sanctions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an additional tax of 20% of the unpaid corporate tax (30% if the return is fraudulent or grossly unfaithful); understatement penalty of 10% of the under-reported amount (20% for intentional concealment); unpaid tax interest of approximately 0.022% per day accrues on the outstanding balance. Persistent evasion can lead to criminal indictment under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act with imprisonment up to three years and fines up to three times the evaded tax; the tax authorities may also refuse refunds, enforce seizure, and impose departure restrictions on the responsible director.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 22% aggregate withholding tax on Korean-source dividends paid to non-resident corporate shareholders, comprising 20% national normal tax under the Corporate Tax Act and 2% local income tax surcharge.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a bilateral double tax treaty, the non-resident shareholder must (1) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the residence-country tax authority, apostilled or legalized if required; (2) submit before the dividend payment a written Application for Non-Resident Tax Exemption or Reduction on HomeTax together with the beneficial ownership certificate showing no pass-through arrangement; (3) provide the Korean withholding agent with treaty article, ownership percentage, and period-of-holding declarations; and (4) allow the Korean company to file the withholding report and, if excess tax was withheld, submit a claim for refund through HomeTax within the general three-year statutory period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates on outbound royalties and intercompany interest are 20% national withholding plus 2% local income tax, aggregate 22%; most Korean DTAs reduce royalties and interest to 10%, with some treaties providing a lower or zero rate on qualifying business profits or government interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File preparation is mandatory when cross-border related-party transactions equal or exceed KRW 50 billion; Master File is also mandatory when total revenue equals or exceeds KRW 100 billion and the related-party transaction threshold is met.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Korea does not maintain a separate Economic Substance Regulations code, but substance-over-form rules under Corporate Tax Act Article 4 and the general anti-avoidance rule in the Law for Coordination of International Tax Affairs require the Yuhan Hoesa to demonstrate real personnel, premises, business activities, and decision-making in Korea; a pass-through shell without Core Income-Generating Activities in Korea may lose treaty benefits, be recharacterized as a sham, and be assessed as a permanent establishment of the foreign shareholder.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion by suppressed export revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-reporting of sales of pre-packaged hotpot base bricks, issuance of fake cash-sale receipts, use of offshore nominee accounts, or destruction of export invoices to reduce Korean taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act, imprisonment for not more than three years or a fine of not less than one time and not more than three times the evaded tax; the National Tax Service imposes additional tax of 30% of unpaid tax plus 0.022% daily interest and disallows carried-forward losses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A directing mind who ordered or benefitted from the evasion becomes jointly and severally liable for the corporation's unpaid tax under the National Tax Collection Act Article 25; assets of the director may be seized, departure from Korea may be banned, and the director may be subject to criminal imprisonment and debarment from corporate management.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer pricing and profit stripping through intercompany payments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying inflated royalties, procurement mark-ups, or interest to a related offshore hotpot base supplier so that the Korean distributor reports artificially low profits or losses, diverging from arm's-length behavior.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authorities may make transfer pricing adjustments under the Law for Coordination of International Tax Affairs, restore the Korean tax base, impose an understatement penalty of 10% to 20% on the recomputed tax, and assess daily late-payment interest; falsified TP documentation may trigger criminal referral.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false related-party transaction statements and intercompany agreements can be personally assessed for the additional corporate tax if they acted intentionally or negligently in causing the underpayment; the NTS may impose a departure blacklist, freeze personal bank accounts, and pursue civil restitution of diverted profit through the National Tax Collection Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell entity / treaty shopping without economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Korean Yuhan Hoesa as a letterbox vehicle with no employees, no physical premises, and retail distribution activities wholly performed by a related non-resident entity, solely to route income and claim reduced dividend, interest, or royalty withholding under a DTA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The NTS can apply the anti-avoidance provision of the Law for Coordination of International Tax Affairs, deny treaty benefits, recharacterize transactions, and assess full 22% WHT on outbound dividends together with negligence penalties on the unfaithful withholding return; the foreign corporate shareholder may be deemed to have a Korean permanent establishment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the foreign shareholder and the local nominee director may be jointly liable for the unpaid withholding tax and penalties; Korean courts can pierce the corporate veil where the shell structure constitutes fraud or evades tax, allowing seizure of personal assets, travel bans, and criminal prosecution for aiding tax evasion.
